title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Massachusetts Port Authority.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agrement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissionres James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Judith F. Judson. (DTE 05-GC-12)
